title: A birthday present
summary: A girl's birthday and the present her grandpa gave her.

sentences.zh: 上个星期六是我的生日，我十五岁了。
sentences.en: Last Saturday was my birthday; I turned fifteen.
I was very happy that day.

sentences.zh: 早上，妈妈给我做了一个很大的蛋糕。
sentences.en: In the morning Mum made me a very big cake.

sentences.zh: 下午，我的好朋友小美来我家了。
sentences.en: In the afternoon, my good friend Xiaomei came to my home.

sentences.zh: 她送我一本书，是她自己在书店买的。
sentences.en: She gave me a book; she bought it at a bookshop herself.
In the evening, Grandpa and Grandma came too.

sentences.zh: 我问爷爷：'这块手表是在哪儿买的？'
sentences.en: I asked Grandpa: 'Where did you buy this watch?'

sentences.zh: 爷爷笑着说：'不是买的，是你奶奶送我的。'
sentences.en: Grandpa smiled and said: 'I didn't buy it. Your grandma gave it to me.'

why: It's 十五, not 五十.

questions.prompt: Where did Grandpa's watch come from?
options: He bought it at a shop
why: He says 不是买的 — it wasn't bought.
Xiaomei gave a book, not the watch.
